Classification: 1 Tier: 0.
It weighs 16.50 oz.

Notes

Machetes can be used to cut down Wild Growths, Jungle Grass, and Venorean Spice. This item can be used to cut 100 Jungle Grass in order to gain Nothing Can Stop Me achievement. Secret Agent Tools can be used as a machete.
